fusions.name: Starting Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 40 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scatter Round
fusions.desc: Looses 3 pellets at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Longer Pull
fusions.desc: Your attacks and spells reach 50% further for 20 seconds. You restore 12 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Powder Burn
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
